--- pipe_order_by.sql
FROM t |> ORDER BY a DESC NULLS    LAST, b ASC NULLS FIRST,

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 6,
            Name:    "t",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeOrderBy{
        Pipe:  7,
        Items: []*ast.OrderByItem{
          &ast.OrderByItem{
            DirPos: 21,
            Expr:   &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 19,
              NameEnd: 20,
              Name:    "a",
            },
            Dir:       "DESC",
            NullOrder: &ast.NullOrder{
              Nulls:   26,
              ModePos: 35,
              Mode:    "LAST",
            },
          },
          &ast.OrderByItem{
            DirPos: 43,
            Expr:   &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 41,
              NameEnd: 42,
              Name:    "b",
            },
            Dir:       "ASC",
            NullOrder: &ast.NullOrder{
              Nulls:   47,
              ModePos: 53,
              Mode:    "FIRST",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM t |> ORDER BY a DESC NULLS LAST, b ASC NULLS FIRST
